outcome: Case fatality rate related to microcephaly/CZS
cohort: The study included cases and deaths related to microcephaly/congenital Zika syndrome in Brazil between 2015 and 2017.
finding: The microcephaly/CZS case fatality rate was 10%, and death related to microcephaly/CZS was significantly associated with moderate and very low birth weight, late preterm births, and low Apgar scores.
birth_weight: Moderate birth weight, very low birth weight (as characteristics of babies included and analyzed)
gest_age: Late preterm births (as a characteristic of babies included and analyzed)
